name: Marcos Kano
paragraphs: My name is Marcos Kano, I graduated from College of Southern Nevada with a Physical Sciences Degree at 18 year old, now I am a student at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. My academic pursuits reflect a strong passion for software development, with a particular interest in becoming a full stack developer. Currently, I am in my junior year, pursuing a double major in Computer Science and Mathematics, alongside a double concentration in Software Engineering and Information Assurance.

As the co-founder of Evidence LLC, I consistently identify opportunities to leverage my skills to enhance the company's operations. I have successfully developed software that is currently integrated into the company's daily workflow. Seeking to further enhance my abilities and gain valuable industry insights, I am currently seeking an internship opportunity to grow as a developer and broaden my knowledge within the field.

I am working on the FES project for my internship at DRIVEN NeuroRecovery Center; I am creating a simulator for their Functional Electrical Stimulation. It has been going great! I recently got a certificate from code academy in Phaser.js Framework, which I will use in this project. I have been learning so much, from CSS, HTML, and JavaScript to working with Blender to create the animations for the program.

I am originally from Brazil! Born in Sao Paulo, lived in Rio de Janeiro for a while, and then moved to the United States when I was about to turn 12 years old. I graduated high school with 75 college credits, an associate's degree from the College of Southern Nevada with a Physical Science degree, and a scholarship to complete my bachelor's in Computer Science and Mathematics, which I am working on right now at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. Also! I was born on March 14, 2005, π day!
